work_rules.authority: Peraturan Pemerintah No. 35 Tahun 2021 Pasal 27(1) — an employer who employs a worker beyond the Pasal 21(2) working hours must pay overtime wages; the regulation sets no wage threshold, and its only exception (Pasal 27(2)) is by job group, which this workspace cannot yet express. Pasal 26(1) caps overtime at 4 hours in a day and 18 hours in a week, and Pasal 26(2) puts overtime worked on a weekly rest day or an official public holiday outside that cap. Undang-Undang No. 13 Tahun 2003 Pasal 79(2)(a) as amended by Undang-Undang No. 6 Tahun 2023 gives a break of at least 30 minutes after 4 continuous hours, not counted as working time, and Pasal 79(2)(b) one rest day for every 6 working days in a week. Applied 2026-09-18: PP 35/2021 art.32(1)–(4): the overtime hour is 1/173 of the monthly wage, basic plus the fixed allowances (`terms.monthly_wage`); art.21: the normal day is seven hours on a six-day week, eight on a five-day one (`normal_hours`); art.26(2): rest-day and holiday overtime are outside the four-hour and eighteen-hour ceilings, which the monthly counter already leaves out. Applied 2026-09-18 (4): PP 35/2021 art.28: overtime is on the employer’s order with the worker’s consent — an ordinary-day overrun the employer did not order (`work_days.requested_by` EMPLOYEE) earns no overtime; the order is presumed unless HR marks the day. Art.27(2): the exception for a job group of planners, thinkers and executors paid above the norm is the MANAGERIAL classification the employer designates (`overtime_when`). Recorded default 2026-09-28 (register ID-106): no instrument fixes how a monthly wage is divided for a part month — PP 36/2021 art.17's ÷25/÷21 converts only a wage fixed daily, and art.40(1) says only that no wage is due for days not worked — so the PK/PP/PKB governs; absent one, a joiner, a leaver and an unpaid day are priced on calendar days (`proration.by` CALENDAR_DAYS): the monthly wage ÷ the month's calendar days for each day, so 9,300,000 is 310,000 a day in April and 300,000 in May.

contract_rules.authority: PP 36/2021 arts.20, 24 and PP 49/2025 art.21: from one year's service the company wage structure and scale apply to the worker; the scale reference's file is its evidence (terms_facts). UU 13/2003 art.22(1)–(3): a lawful apprenticeship needs a written apprenticeship agreement with rights, duties and duration; absent it, the participant becomes the company’s worker. The law does not exempt an employee labelled INTERN or APPRENTICE from the worker minimum wage. The floor therefore covers every employment row (`applies_when` empty); a genuine nonemployee apprenticeship and its stipend require verified legal-status facts and a separate path, not a label-based payroll exemption. encashment.authority: UU 13/2003 art.156(4)(a) as amended by UU 6/2023 art.81 and PP 35/2021 art.40(4)(a): uang penggantian hak includes annual leave not yet taken and not yet expired, with no amount or divisor. UU 13/2003 art.79(4) as amended: the implementation of annual leave is regulated in the employment agreement, company regulation or collective agreement. Art.157(1) as amended fixes the wage components (basic wage and fixed allowances) only for uang pesangon and UPMK, no longer for uang penggantian hak, and PP 36/2021 art.17 (monthly wage ÷25 on a six-day week, ÷21 on a five-day week) sets the daily wage only where wages are fixed daily. The Kemnaker JDIH item of 5 November 2014 (1/30 of the monthly wage) is an explanatory news item, not a regulation. The day is therefore priced from the entity's declared PK/PP/PKB basis: `leave_cash_out_wage_basis` (basic wage, or basic wage plus the contract's fixed allowances) divided by `leave_cash_out_day_divisor`; an entity that records neither stops the cash-out by name. Contract-listed allowances are paid regularly irrespective of attendance, so they are fixed allowances when the declared basis includes them. PP 36/2021 art.15 fixes time-unit wages only per jam, harian or bulanan: a daily wage is itself the day (art.17 converts a month into a day only where wages are fixed daily, and the day here is already fixed); a per-hour wage (art.16(1), part-time only) is the hour times the contract's normal hours of the day; a monthly fixed allowance adds its declared-divisor day share when the declared basis includes it. A weekly wage is not a time unit PP 36/2021 art.15 recognises, so a WEEKLY contract has no valuation rule. Source: https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/asset/data_puu/PP362021.pdf (signed SALINAN, linked from https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/peraturan/detail/1724; arts 15–17 read from the page images, pp. 10–11).

final_pay_deadlines.authority: PP 36/2021 art.55(1): wages are paid at the time agreed between employer and worker, the interval at most one month (art.55(4)); a final wage is still a wage, so it falls due on the agreed payday of the period the exit falls in. No instrument sets a shorter post-exit deadline (UU 13/2003 art.156(1) owes severance on termination without a day count); the late-wage fine of art.61(1) runs from the fourth day after the agreed date.

deduction_ceiling.authority: PP 36/2021 art.65: the deductions of art.63(1) — fines, damages, wage advances, rent, debts or their instalments, overpaid wages — may total at most 50% of each wage payment; contributions to the state and to social-security bodies are deducted under art.64(3), outside art.63, so the employee's BPJS share and PPh 21 are not counted, nor is the pension offset against separation pay (not a wage deduction). No final-payment exception.

sources.instructions:
Sources are the primary instrument first — the statute or regulation in the national law database, the gazette, or the table the authority itself publishes — one page per fact the version seals, never a news article or a commentary. A historical version lists the instruments in force on its own effective date. Where the primary host refuses the reader (sso.agc.gov.sg, officialgazette.gov.ph, peraturan.bpk.go.id, kwsp.gov.my, hrdcorp.gov.my answer 403 to Norbital-Public-Page-Reader) the authority’s own published table is listed instead, or the Wayback Machine’s dated copy of the authority’s own page or PDF (web.archive.org/web/<timestamp>id_/<url>) — never a host the reader cannot open.
peraturan.bpk.go.id — JDIH BPK, the most complete national legal database. /Details/<id>/<slug> is the instrument page (abstract, status, amendments); /Download/<id>/<file>.pdf the text (Perpres 64/2020 0.5 MB reads; Perpres 59/2024 3.2 MB does not — cite the Details page and the Kemenkeu copy instead). Search is /Search?keywords=<number>.
jdih.kemnaker.go.id — Ministry of Manpower: /peraturan/detail/<id>/<slug> pages and /asset/data_puu/<file>.pdf texts. PP 35/2021 (PP352021.pdf, 2.4 MB) and PP 6/2025 (2025pp006.pdf, 4.3 MB) exceed the reader limit: read the detail page and quote the Kemnaker summary, or the BPK Details page.
jdih.kemenkeu.go.id — /api/download/FullText/<year>/<file>.pdf (Perpres 82/2018 at 1.3 MB reads).
pajak.go.id — PMK 168/2023 TER tables at /sites/default/files/2024-02/PMK 168 Tahun 2023 Tentang PPh Pasal 21 TER.pdf (2.9 MB, over the limit): the Details page on peraturan.bpk.go.id carries the same annex.
setneg.go.id — /baca/index/inilah_skb_3_menteri_libur_nasional_dan_cuti_bersama_<year>: the SKB 3 Menteri holiday and cuti bersama list, HTML.
bpjsketenagakerjaan.go.id — /assets/uploads/peraturan/<file>.pdf hold PP 44/45/46 of 2015; /artikel/<id>/… states the JHT/JKK/JKM/JP/JKP rates; the JP ceiling circular (SE) is announced under /berita/<id>/….
jdih.jakarta.go.id — /dokumen/detail/<id>: the DKI Kepgub UMP for the year. jdih.jabarprov.go.id — /page/eksekusi_download/32/<file>.pdf: the Jawa Barat UMK decree.
hukumonline, pasal.id, kontan and other press are corroboration only.

facts.label: Enterprise size for BPJS Kesehatan
facts.description: Declare OTHER only after verifying that this employer is not a micro or small enterprise. Perpres 82/2018 art.32(4)–(5), as amended by Perpres 59/2024, excludes micro and small enterprises from the ordinary UMP/UMK BPJS Kesehatan contribution floor; their separate floor requires an actuarial determination. This declaration does not exempt wages from PP 36/2021 minimum-wage rules.

facts.label: Eligible PPh21 DTP sector
facts.description: Employer meets the eligible principal KLU and registration/reference-date conditions of PMK 10/2025 as amended by PMK 72/2025 (2025), or PMK 105/2025 art.3 (2026). Confirm from the DJP record, not merely the current industry label. Employee tax identity, reference-month pay and other incentives are separate PPH21 declarations.

facts.label: Leave cash-out daily divisor
facts.description: The divisor of the monthly wage basis that the employment agreement, company regulation or collective agreement fixes for unused annual leave (UU 13/2003 art.79(4) as amended). Required before any annual leave is cashed out.

facts.label: Leave cash-out wage basis
facts.description: The monthly wage the employment agreement, company regulation or collective agreement values unused annual leave on: BASIC (basic wage) or BASIC_AND_FIXED_ALLOWANCES. Required before any annual leave is cashed out.

facts.label: Labour-intensive JKK relief (PP 7/2025)
facts.description: BPJS Ketenagakerjaan has verified the employer as a labour-intensive enterprise under PP 7/2025 art.3(3)–(4) and art.5(2): at least 50 workers registered as active participants, in the food, beverage and tobacco, textile and apparel, leather and leather goods, footwear, children's toy or furniture industry. Halves JKK for the February 2025 to January 2026 contribution months (art.4(1), art.10; PP 36/2025 art.10A).

facts.label: Construction-services employer (JKK 1.74%)
facts.description: The employer is a Pemberi Kerja Jasa Konstruksi that registers its project workers with BPJS Ketenagakerjaan under Permenaker 5/2021 BAB IV (arts.65–67, as amended by Permenaker 1/2025). Its daily casual, piece and fixed-term workers pay JKK at 1.74% of the known monthly wage (art.71(1)), whatever the risk group. Owner rule 2026-09-28: law silent on an unrecorded status; default false; lawful because the employer registers each project itself (art.67).

facts.label: Hotel star class (sector minimum wage)
facts.description: The verified hotel star class; 0 means affirmatively classified as a non-star hotel. Bali Kep.946/03-M/HK/2024 applies the 2025 Badung UMSK only to five-star hotels under KBLI 2020 55110. An unverified class must stop sector selection rather than default to zero.

facts.label: Large business for Jepara sector minimum wage
facts.description: Jepara's amended 2025 UMSK applies to the listed KBLI only for a large-scale enterprise (Kep. Gubernur Jawa Tengah 100.3.3.1/45 Tahun 2025, Lampiran, Keterangan: skala usaha besar). Verify and record the enterprise's legally classified scale before applying or excluding this sector floor.

exit_facts.label: PP 35/2021 termination cause
exit_facts.description: The specific statutory ground; the broad departure reason does not choose a benefit multiplier.

exit_facts.label: Daily wage for separation
exit_facts.description: Article 157(2): the separation monthly wage is 30 times this daily wage.

exit_facts.label: Average output-paid income, last 12 months
exit_facts.description: Article 157(3)-(4): the average is floored at the applicable regional minimum wage.

exit_facts.label: Employer-funded pension benefit
exit_facts.description: Only the benefit attributable to employer contributions may offset termination obligations.

exit_facts.label: Pension offset agreement reference
exit_facts.description: Article 58(3) requires the offset arrangement in the employment agreement, company regulation or collective agreement.

exit_facts.label: Religious holiday the THR is judged against
exit_facts.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Permenaker 6/2016 art.7(1): a PKWTT worker whose employment ends within the thirty days before the religious holiday keeps the THR; art.2(1) and art.5(4): a worker employed on the holiday is owed it; art.7(3): a PKWT that ends before the holiday is not. The religious holiday is the employee’s own (art.1(2): Idul Fitri for a Muslim, Natal for a Christian or Catholic, Nyepi for a Hindu, Waisak for a Buddhist, Imlek for a Confucian), on the date of the government’s joint ministerial decree (SKB) for its year: the first such holiday on or after the thirtieth day before the last day of work.
exit_facts.validation_message: Religious holiday the THR is judged against must be a date written YYYY-MM-DD.

terms_facts.label: Company wage-scale grade
terms_facts.description: PP 36/2021 arts.20, 24 and PP 49/2025 art.21: this worker's grade in the company wage structure and scale, read once service reaches one year.

terms_facts.label: Wage-scale basic-wage minimum
terms_facts.description: The basic-wage minimum of that grade in the company scale (not the government UMP/UMK), in the terms' currency.

terms_facts.label: Wage scale effective on
terms_facts.description: The day the company wage structure and scale took effect.

terms_facts.label: Grade notice given on
terms_facts.description: The day this worker was notified of the grade.

terms_facts.label: Wage scale and grade notice reference
terms_facts.description: The company scale and this worker's individual grade notice; the file is its evidence.

terms_facts.label: Prior work in Indonesia
terms_facts.description: A short-contract foreigner's prior work in Indonesia, checked for the BPJS Kesehatan six-month work condition.

terms_facts.label: Prior work reviewed on
terms_facts.description: The day the prior-work record was reviewed; its reference is the evidence.

terms_facts.label: Worksite KBLI edition
terms_facts.description: The KBLI edition the worksite sector code is stated in.

terms_facts.label: Probation ends on
terms_facts.description: The last day of an agreed PKWTT probation (masa percobaan): UU 13/2003 art.60(1) caps it at three months from the first day of work, and art.60(2) keeps the minimum wage during it. Absent where no probation was agreed; a PKWT (fixed-term contract) may not state one (UU 13/2003 art.58(1); PP 35/2021 art.12).

name: Indonesia — 2026-01-01
change_summary: The 2026 UMP under PP 49/2025 (DKI Jakarta 5,729,876; Jawa Barat 2,317,601; Kabupaten Bekasi 5,938,885) lifts the ordinary-PPU BPJS Kesehatan floor on 1 January 2026. Nothing else moves.

work_rules.authority: Peraturan Pemerintah No. 35 Tahun 2021 Pasal 27(1) — an employer who employs a worker beyond the Pasal 21(2) working hours must pay overtime wages; the regulation sets no wage threshold, and its only exception (Pasal 27(2)) is by job group, which this workspace cannot yet express. Pasal 26(1) caps overtime at 4 hours in a day and 18 hours in a week, and Pasal 26(2) puts overtime worked on a weekly rest day or an official public holiday outside that cap. Undang-Undang No. 13 Tahun 2003 Pasal 79(2)(a) as amended by Undang-Undang No. 6 Tahun 2023 gives a break of at least 30 minutes after 4 continuous hours, not counted as working time, and Pasal 79(2)(b) one rest day for every 6 working days in a week. Applied 2026-09-18: PP 35/2021 art.32(1)–(4): the overtime hour is 1/173 of the monthly wage, basic plus the fixed allowances (`terms.monthly_wage`); art.21: the normal day is seven hours on a six-day week, eight on a five-day one (`normal_hours`); art.26(2): rest-day and holiday overtime are outside the four-hour and eighteen-hour ceilings, which the monthly counter already leaves out. Applied 2026-09-18 (4): PP 35/2021 art.28: overtime is on the employer’s order with the worker’s consent — an ordinary-day overrun the employer did not order (`work_days.requested_by` EMPLOYEE) earns no overtime; the order is presumed unless HR marks the day. Art.27(2): the exception for a job group of planners, thinkers and executors paid above the norm is the MANAGERIAL classification the employer designates (`overtime_when`). Recorded default 2026-09-28 (register ID-106): no instrument fixes how a monthly wage is divided for a part month — PP 36/2021 art.17's ÷25/÷21 converts only a wage fixed daily, and art.40(1) says only that no wage is due for days not worked — so the PK/PP/PKB governs; absent one, a joiner, a leaver and an unpaid day are priced on calendar days (`proration.by` CALENDAR_DAYS): the monthly wage ÷ the month's calendar days for each day, so 9,300,000 is 310,000 a day in April and 300,000 in May.

ordinary_rate.day: terms.pay_frequency == "HOURLY" ? terms.basic_salary * terms.ordinary_hours_per_week / terms.working_days_per_week : terms.pay_frequency == "DAILY" ? terms.basic_salary : (terms.pay_frequency == "WEEKLY" ? 52.0 / 12.0 : 1.0) * terms.ordinary_hours_per_week / terms.working_days_per_week * terms.monthly_wage / 173.0

encashment.day_amount: terms.pay_frequency == "DAILY" ? terms.basic_salary + (company.facts.leave_cash_out_wage_basis == "BASIC" ? 0.0 : terms.fixed_allowances / company.facts.leave_cash_out_day_divisor) : terms.pay_frequency == "HOURLY" ? terms.basic_salary * terms.ordinary_hours_per_week / terms.working_days_per_week + (company.facts.leave_cash_out_wage_basis == "BASIC" ? 0.0 : terms.fixed_allowances / company.facts.leave_cash_out_day_divisor) : (company.facts.leave_cash_out_wage_basis == "BASIC" ? terms.basic_salary : terms.monthly_wage) / company.facts.leave_cash_out_day_divisor
encashment.authority: UU 13/2003 art.156(4)(a) as amended by UU 6/2023 art.81 and PP 35/2021 art.40(4)(a): uang penggantian hak includes annual leave not yet taken and not yet expired, with no amount or divisor. UU 13/2003 art.79(4) as amended: the implementation of annual leave is regulated in the employment agreement, company regulation or collective agreement. Art.157(1) as amended fixes the wage components (basic wage and fixed allowances) only for uang pesangon and UPMK, no longer for uang penggantian hak, and PP 36/2021 art.17 (monthly wage ÷25 on a six-day week, ÷21 on a five-day week) sets the daily wage only where wages are fixed daily. The Kemnaker JDIH item of 5 November 2014 (1/30 of the monthly wage) is an explanatory news item, not a regulation. The day is therefore priced from the entity's declared PK/PP/PKB basis: `leave_cash_out_wage_basis` (basic wage, or basic wage plus the contract's fixed allowances) divided by `leave_cash_out_day_divisor`; an entity that records neither stops the cash-out by name. Contract-listed allowances are paid regularly irrespective of attendance, so they are fixed allowances when the declared basis includes them. PP 36/2021 art.15 fixes time-unit wages only per jam, harian or bulanan: a daily wage is itself the day (art.17 converts a month into a day only where wages are fixed daily, and the day here is already fixed); a per-hour wage (art.16(1), part-time only) is the hour times the contract's normal hours of the day; a monthly fixed allowance adds its declared-divisor day share when the declared basis includes it. A weekly wage is not a time unit PP 36/2021 art.15 recognises, so a WEEKLY contract has no valuation rule. Source: https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/asset/data_puu/PP362021.pdf (signed SALINAN, linked from https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/peraturan/detail/1724; arts 15–17 read from the page images, pp. 10–11).

final_pay_deadlines.authority: PP 36/2021 art.55(1): wages are paid at the time agreed between employer and worker, the interval at most one month (art.55(4)); a final wage is still a wage, so it falls due on the agreed payday of the period the exit falls in. No instrument sets a shorter post-exit deadline (UU 13/2003 art.156(1) owes severance on termination without a day count); the late-wage fine of art.61(1) runs from the fourth day after the agreed date.

deduction_ceiling.authority: PP 36/2021 art.65: the deductions of art.63(1) — fines, damages, wage advances, rent, debts or their instalments, overpaid wages — may total at most 50% of each wage payment; contributions to the state and to social-security bodies are deducted under art.64(3), outside art.63, so the employee's BPJS share and PPh 21 are not counted, nor is the pension offset against separation pay (not a wage deduction). No final-payment exception.

sources.instructions:
Sources are the primary instrument first — the statute or regulation in the national law database, the gazette, or the table the authority itself publishes — one page per fact the version seals, never a news article or a commentary. A historical version lists the instruments in force on its own effective date. Where the primary host refuses the reader (sso.agc.gov.sg, officialgazette.gov.ph, peraturan.bpk.go.id, kwsp.gov.my, hrdcorp.gov.my answer 403 to Norbital-Public-Page-Reader) the authority’s own published table is listed instead, or the Wayback Machine’s dated copy of the authority’s own page or PDF (web.archive.org/web/<timestamp>id_/<url>) — never a host the reader cannot open.
peraturan.bpk.go.id — JDIH BPK, the most complete national legal database. /Details/<id>/<slug> is the instrument page (abstract, status, amendments); /Download/<id>/<file>.pdf the text (Perpres 64/2020 0.5 MB reads; Perpres 59/2024 3.2 MB does not — cite the Details page and the Kemenkeu copy instead). Search is /Search?keywords=<number>.
jdih.kemnaker.go.id — Ministry of Manpower: /peraturan/detail/<id>/<slug> pages and /asset/data_puu/<file>.pdf texts. PP 35/2021 (PP352021.pdf, 2.4 MB) and PP 6/2025 (2025pp006.pdf, 4.3 MB) exceed the reader limit: read the detail page and quote the Kemnaker summary, or the BPK Details page.
jdih.kemenkeu.go.id — /api/download/FullText/<year>/<file>.pdf (Perpres 82/2018 at 1.3 MB reads).
pajak.go.id — PMK 168/2023 TER tables at /sites/default/files/2024-02/PMK 168 Tahun 2023 Tentang PPh Pasal 21 TER.pdf (2.9 MB, over the limit): the Details page on peraturan.bpk.go.id carries the same annex.
setneg.go.id — /baca/index/inilah_skb_3_menteri_libur_nasional_dan_cuti_bersama_<year>: the SKB 3 Menteri holiday and cuti bersama list, HTML.
bpjsketenagakerjaan.go.id — /assets/uploads/peraturan/<file>.pdf hold PP 44/45/46 of 2015; /artikel/<id>/… states the JHT/JKK/JKM/JP/JKP rates; the JP ceiling circular (SE) is announced under /berita/<id>/….
jdih.jakarta.go.id — /dokumen/detail/<id>: the DKI Kepgub UMP for the year. jdih.jabarprov.go.id — /page/eksekusi_download/32/<file>.pdf: the Jawa Barat UMK decree.
hukumonline, pasal.id, kontan and other press are corroboration only.

Finding changes (read these before comparing, every run):
Labour: open https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/peraturan?keyword=<term>&sort=terbaru (terms: upah, pengupahan, cuti bersama, libur, jaminan, lembur, THR, pesangon) and read the top rows (type, nomor, 'Ditetapkan' date). The detail page links the PDF under /asset/data_puu/. Tax: https://www.pajak.go.id/id/peraturan (newest first, &page=N) and https://jdih.kemenkeu.go.id/search?q=<term>&order=desc (q works; 'keyword' does not). Open /dok/pmk-<n>-tahun-<yyyy>. BPJS TK: berita.html for JP-ceiling SEs; peraturan.html for PPs. BPJS Kesehatan is an Angular shell, so find Perpres JKN changes via Kemnaker JDIH/setneg news and cite the Perpres PDF. UMP/UMK: Kemnaker announces by 1 Nov (UMP) / ~Dec; open jdih.jakarta.go.id homepage for the Kepgub. jdih.jabarprov.go.id and peraturan.bpk.go.id 403 to readers — use Wayback id_ copies or the Kemnaker/BPJS copy. Holidays: kemenkopmk.go.id/pengumuman SKB PDF is a scan; the date list is in the setneg.go.id news text. Discovery only: DDTC News, Ortax, PwC Indonesia Tax Alerts.

facts.label: Enterprise size for BPJS Kesehatan
facts.description: Declare OTHER only after verifying that this employer is not a micro or small enterprise. Perpres 82/2018 art.32(4)–(5), as amended by Perpres 59/2024, excludes micro and small enterprises from the ordinary UMP/UMK BPJS Kesehatan contribution floor; their separate floor requires an actuarial determination. This declaration does not exempt wages from PP 36/2021 minimum-wage rules.

facts.label: Eligible PPh21 DTP sector
facts.description: Employer meets the eligible principal KLU and registration/reference-date conditions of PMK 10/2025 as amended by PMK 72/2025 (2025), or PMK 105/2025 art.3 (2026). Confirm from the DJP record, not merely the current industry label. Employee tax identity, reference-month pay and other incentives are separate PPH21 declarations.

facts.label: Leave cash-out daily divisor
facts.description: The divisor of the monthly wage basis that the employment agreement, company regulation or collective agreement fixes for unused annual leave (UU 13/2003 art.79(4) as amended). Required before any annual leave is cashed out.

facts.label: Leave cash-out wage basis
facts.description: The monthly wage the employment agreement, company regulation or collective agreement values unused annual leave on: BASIC (basic wage) or BASIC_AND_FIXED_ALLOWANCES. Required before any annual leave is cashed out.

facts.label: Export-oriented (sector minimum wage)
facts.description: The employer is an exporter where a sector minimum wage binds only exporters (DKI Kep.33/2026 Lampiran A rows 10–11, KBLI 14111 and 15201: "EKSPOR"). Owner rule 2026-09-28: law silent on an unrecorded condition; default false; lawful because the decree binds only employers that meet the condition, which the employer records, and the run warns rather than pays.

facts.label: Assets above Rp1 trillion (sector minimum wage)
facts.description: The employer’s assets exceed Rp1,000,000,000,000 where a sector minimum wage binds only such employers (DKI Kep.33/2026 Lampiran A row 18, KBLI 21012; Lampiran D rows 51–52, KBLI 64121 and 64122: "ASET DI ATAS 1 TRILIUN"). Owner rule 2026-09-28: law silent on an unrecorded condition; default false; lawful because the decree binds only employers that meet the condition, which the employer records, and the run warns rather than pays.

facts.label: Astra group member (sector minimum wage)
facts.description: The employer belongs to the Astra group where a sector minimum wage binds only it (DKI Kep.33/2026 Lampiran A rows 38–43: "ASTRA GROUP"). Owner rule 2026-09-28: law silent on an unrecorded condition; default false; lawful because the decree binds only employers that meet the condition, which the employer records, and the run warns rather than pays.

facts.label: Hotel star class (sector minimum wage)
facts.description: The verified hotel star class; 0 means affirmatively classified as a non-star hotel. DKI Kep.33/2026 Lampiran F row 60 applies to four/five-star KBLI 55110 hotels; Bali Kep.1021/2025 applies Badung UMSK to four/five-star KBLI 55110 hotels. An unverified class must stop sector selection rather than default to zero.

facts.label: Labour-intensive JKK relief (PP 7/2025)
facts.description: BPJS Ketenagakerjaan has verified the employer as a labour-intensive enterprise under PP 7/2025 art.3(3)–(4) and art.5(2): at least 50 workers registered as active participants, in the food, beverage and tobacco, textile and apparel, leather and leather goods, footwear, children's toy or furniture industry. Halves JKK for the February 2025 to January 2026 contribution months (art.4(1), art.10; PP 36/2025 art.10A).

facts.label: Construction-services employer (JKK 1.74%)
facts.description: The employer is a Pemberi Kerja Jasa Konstruksi that registers its project workers with BPJS Ketenagakerjaan under Permenaker 5/2021 BAB IV (arts.65–67, as amended by Permenaker 1/2025). Its daily casual, piece and fixed-term workers pay JKK at 1.74% of the known monthly wage (art.71(1)), whatever the risk group. Owner rule 2026-09-28: law silent on an unrecorded status; default false; lawful because the employer registers each project itself (art.67).

exit_facts.label: PP 35/2021 termination cause
exit_facts.description: The specific statutory ground; the broad departure reason does not choose a benefit multiplier.

exit_facts.label: Daily wage for separation
exit_facts.description: Article 157(2): the separation monthly wage is 30 times this daily wage.

exit_facts.label: Average output-paid income, last 12 months
exit_facts.description: Article 157(3)-(4): the average is floored at the applicable regional minimum wage.

exit_facts.label: Employer-funded pension benefit
exit_facts.description: Only the benefit attributable to employer contributions may offset termination obligations.

exit_facts.label: Pension offset agreement reference
exit_facts.description: Article 58(3) requires the offset arrangement in the employment agreement, company regulation or collective agreement.

exit_facts.label: Religious holiday the THR is judged against
exit_facts.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Permenaker 6/2016 art.7(1): a PKWTT worker whose employment ends within the thirty days before the religious holiday keeps the THR; art.2(1) and art.5(4): a worker employed on the holiday is owed it; art.7(3): a PKWT that ends before the holiday is not. The religious holiday is the employee’s own (art.1(2): Idul Fitri for a Muslim, Natal for a Christian or Catholic, Nyepi for a Hindu, Waisak for a Buddhist, Imlek for a Confucian), on the date of the government’s joint ministerial decree (SKB) for its year: the first such holiday on or after the thirtieth day before the last day of work.
exit_facts.validation_message: Religious holiday the THR is judged against must be a date written YYYY-MM-DD.

terms_facts.label: Company wage-scale grade
terms_facts.description: PP 36/2021 arts.20, 24 and PP 49/2025 art.21: this worker's grade in the company wage structure and scale, read once service reaches one year.

terms_facts.label: Wage-scale basic-wage minimum
terms_facts.description: The basic-wage minimum of that grade in the company scale (not the government UMP/UMK), in the terms' currency.

terms_facts.label: Wage scale effective on
terms_facts.description: The day the company wage structure and scale took effect.

terms_facts.label: Grade notice given on
terms_facts.description: The day this worker was notified of the grade.

terms_facts.label: Wage scale and grade notice reference
terms_facts.description: The company scale and this worker's individual grade notice; the file is its evidence.

terms_facts.label: Prior work in Indonesia
terms_facts.description: A short-contract foreigner's prior work in Indonesia, checked for the BPJS Kesehatan six-month work condition.

terms_facts.label: Prior work reviewed on
terms_facts.description: The day the prior-work record was reviewed; its reference is the evidence.

terms_facts.label: Worksite KBLI edition
terms_facts.description: The KBLI edition the worksite sector code is stated in.

terms_facts.label: Probation ends on
terms_facts.description: The last day of an agreed PKWTT probation (masa percobaan): UU 13/2003 art.60(1) caps it at three months from the first day of work, and art.60(2) keeps the minimum wage during it. Absent where no probation was agreed; a PKWT (fixed-term contract) may not state one (UU 13/2003 art.58(1); PP 35/2021 art.12).

obligations.authority: Perpres 82/2018 arts.13–14, 17 as amended by Perpres 64/2020 and 59/2024 (https://jdih.kemenkeu.go.id/api/download/FullText/2018/82TAHUN2018PERPRES.pdf)

obligations.trigger: Each month

obligations.owner: Finance / billing code, payment and SPT Masa receipt
obligations.authority: PMK 81/2024 art.94(2) (payment; https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/306614/pmk-no-81-tahun-2024); UU KUP art.3(3)(a) (SPT Masa 20 days); PER-11/PJ/2025 (https://jdih.kemenkeu.go.id/dok/per-11pj2025); late filing Rp100,000 per SPT Masa (UU KUP art.7(1)), late payment interest (art.9(2a))

obligations.description: Issue Form BPA1 (formerly 1721-A1) to each permanent employee for the year, or for the part year to departure

obligations.authority: PER-11/PJ/2025 art.7(2) (https://jdih.kemenkeu.go.id/dok/per-11pj2025); PMK 168/2023 (the annual reckoning the form reports)

obligations.description: Pay no worker below the applicable provincial or city/regency minimum wage; basic wage at least 75% of basic plus fixed allowances

work_rules.authority: Peraturan Pemerintah No. 35 Tahun 2021 Pasal 27(1) — an employer who employs a worker beyond the Pasal 21(2) working hours must pay overtime wages; the regulation sets no wage threshold, and its only exception (Pasal 27(2)) is by job group, which this workspace cannot yet express. Pasal 26(1) caps overtime at 4 hours in a day and 18 hours in a week, and Pasal 26(2) puts overtime worked on a weekly rest day or an official public holiday outside that cap. Undang-Undang No. 13 Tahun 2003 Pasal 79(2)(a) as amended by Undang-Undang No. 6 Tahun 2023 gives a break of at least 30 minutes after 4 continuous hours, not counted as working time, and Pasal 79(2)(b) one rest day for every 6 working days in a week. Applied 2026-09-18: PP 35/2021 art.32(1)–(4): the overtime hour is 1/173 of the monthly wage, basic plus the fixed allowances (`terms.monthly_wage`); art.21: the normal day is seven hours on a six-day week, eight on a five-day one (`normal_hours`); art.26(2): rest-day and holiday overtime are outside the four-hour and eighteen-hour ceilings, which the monthly counter already leaves out. Applied 2026-09-18 (4): PP 35/2021 art.28: overtime is on the employer’s order with the worker’s consent — an ordinary-day overrun the employer did not order (`work_days.requested_by` EMPLOYEE) earns no overtime; the order is presumed unless HR marks the day. Art.27(2): the exception for a job group of planners, thinkers and executors paid above the norm is the MANAGERIAL classification the employer designates (`overtime_when`). Recorded default 2026-09-28 (register ID-106): no instrument fixes how a monthly wage is divided for a part month — PP 36/2021 art.17's ÷25/÷21 converts only a wage fixed daily, and art.40(1) says only that no wage is due for days not worked — so the PK/PP/PKB governs; absent one, a joiner, a leaver and an unpaid day are priced on calendar days (`proration.by` CALENDAR_DAYS): the monthly wage ÷ the month's calendar days for each day, so 9,300,000 is 310,000 a day in April and 300,000 in May.

Added 2026-09-29, effective 1 January 2026: Jawa Timur 38 UMKs from signed Kep.937/2025, UMSP seven KBLI from Kep.935/2025, and 11 locality UMSK schedules with 156 KBLI entries from Kep.938/2025; DIY five UMKs from the provincial announcement of Kep.443/2025; Lampung five UMKs from JDIH Kep.877–881/2025 and UMSP KBLI 10434 Rp3,108,689 from Kep.865/2025; Bali star-hotel UMSP KBLI 55110 Rp3,267,693 and Badung four/five-star UMSK Rp3,828,912.60 from Bali Disnaker announcements. The Lampung ten other localities and condition classification require explicit admission evidence; unknown KBLI, hotel star, and employer facts must block sector selection rather than silently select the lower floor.

ordinary_rate.day: terms.pay_frequency == "HOURLY" ? terms.basic_salary * terms.ordinary_hours_per_week / terms.working_days_per_week : terms.pay_frequency == "DAILY" ? terms.basic_salary : (terms.pay_frequency == "WEEKLY" ? 52.0 / 12.0 : 1.0) * terms.ordinary_hours_per_week / terms.working_days_per_week * terms.monthly_wage / 173.0

encashment.day_amount: terms.pay_frequency == "DAILY" ? terms.basic_salary + (company.facts.leave_cash_out_wage_basis == "BASIC" ? 0.0 : terms.fixed_allowances / company.facts.leave_cash_out_day_divisor) : terms.pay_frequency == "HOURLY" ? terms.basic_salary * terms.ordinary_hours_per_week / terms.working_days_per_week + (company.facts.leave_cash_out_wage_basis == "BASIC" ? 0.0 : terms.fixed_allowances / company.facts.leave_cash_out_day_divisor) : (company.facts.leave_cash_out_wage_basis == "BASIC" ? terms.basic_salary : terms.monthly_wage) / company.facts.leave_cash_out_day_divisor
encashment.authority: UU 13/2003 art.156(4)(a) as amended by UU 6/2023 art.81 and PP 35/2021 art.40(4)(a): uang penggantian hak includes annual leave not yet taken and not yet expired, with no amount or divisor. UU 13/2003 art.79(4) as amended: the implementation of annual leave is regulated in the employment agreement, company regulation or collective agreement. Art.157(1) as amended fixes the wage components (basic wage and fixed allowances) only for uang pesangon and UPMK, no longer for uang penggantian hak, and PP 36/2021 art.17 (monthly wage ÷25 on a six-day week, ÷21 on a five-day week) sets the daily wage only where wages are fixed daily. The Kemnaker JDIH item of 5 November 2014 (1/30 of the monthly wage) is an explanatory news item, not a regulation. The day is therefore priced from the entity's declared PK/PP/PKB basis: `leave_cash_out_wage_basis` (basic wage, or basic wage plus the contract's fixed allowances) divided by `leave_cash_out_day_divisor`; an entity that records neither stops the cash-out by name. Contract-listed allowances are paid regularly irrespective of attendance, so they are fixed allowances when the declared basis includes them. PP 36/2021 art.15 fixes time-unit wages only per jam, harian or bulanan: a daily wage is itself the day (art.17 converts a month into a day only where wages are fixed daily, and the day here is already fixed); a per-hour wage (art.16(1), part-time only) is the hour times the contract's normal hours of the day; a monthly fixed allowance adds its declared-divisor day share when the declared basis includes it. A weekly wage is not a time unit PP 36/2021 art.15 recognises, so a WEEKLY contract has no valuation rule. Source: https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/asset/data_puu/PP362021.pdf (signed SALINAN, linked from https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/peraturan/detail/1724; arts 15–17 read from the page images, pp. 10–11).

final_pay_deadlines.authority: PP 36/2021 art.55(1): wages are paid at the time agreed between employer and worker, the interval at most one month (art.55(4)); a final wage is still a wage, so it falls due on the agreed payday of the period the exit falls in. No instrument sets a shorter post-exit deadline (UU 13/2003 art.156(1) owes severance on termination without a day count); the late-wage fine of art.61(1) runs from the fourth day after the agreed date.

deduction_ceiling.authority: PP 36/2021 art.65: the deductions of art.63(1) — fines, damages, wage advances, rent, debts or their instalments, overpaid wages — may total at most 50% of each wage payment; contributions to the state and to social-security bodies are deducted under art.64(3), outside art.63, so the employee's BPJS share and PPh 21 are not counted, nor is the pension offset against separation pay (not a wage deduction). No final-payment exception.

sources.instructions:
Sources are the primary instrument first — the statute or regulation in the national law database, the gazette, or the table the authority itself publishes — one page per fact the version seals, never a news article or a commentary. A historical version lists the instruments in force on its own effective date. Where the primary host refuses the reader (sso.agc.gov.sg, officialgazette.gov.ph, peraturan.bpk.go.id, kwsp.gov.my, hrdcorp.gov.my answer 403 to Norbital-Public-Page-Reader) the authority’s own published table is listed instead, or the Wayback Machine’s dated copy of the authority’s own page or PDF (web.archive.org/web/<timestamp>id_/<url>) — never a host the reader cannot open.
peraturan.bpk.go.id — JDIH BPK, the most complete national legal database. /Details/<id>/<slug> is the instrument page (abstract, status, amendments); /Download/<id>/<file>.pdf the text (Perpres 64/2020 0.5 MB reads; Perpres 59/2024 3.2 MB does not — cite the Details page and the Kemenkeu copy instead). Search is /Search?keywords=<number>.
jdih.kemnaker.go.id — Ministry of Manpower: /peraturan/detail/<id>/<slug> pages and /asset/data_puu/<file>.pdf texts. PP 35/2021 (PP352021.pdf, 2.4 MB) and PP 6/2025 (2025pp006.pdf, 4.3 MB) exceed the reader limit: read the detail page and quote the Kemnaker summary, or the BPK Details page.
jdih.kemenkeu.go.id — /api/download/FullText/<year>/<file>.pdf (Perpres 82/2018 at 1.3 MB reads).
pajak.go.id — PMK 168/2023 TER tables at /sites/default/files/2024-02/PMK 168 Tahun 2023 Tentang PPh Pasal 21 TER.pdf (2.9 MB, over the limit): the Details page on peraturan.bpk.go.id carries the same annex.
setneg.go.id — /baca/index/inilah_skb_3_menteri_libur_nasional_dan_cuti_bersama_<year>: the SKB 3 Menteri holiday and cuti bersama list, HTML.
bpjsketenagakerjaan.go.id — /assets/uploads/peraturan/<file>.pdf hold PP 44/45/46 of 2015; /artikel/<id>/… states the JHT/JKK/JKM/JP/JKP rates; the JP ceiling circular (SE) is announced under /berita/<id>/….
jdih.jakarta.go.id — /dokumen/detail/<id>: the DKI Kepgub UMP for the year. jdih.jabarprov.go.id — /page/eksekusi_download/32/<file>.pdf: the Jawa Barat UMK decree.
hukumonline, pasal.id, kontan and other press are corroboration only.

Finding changes (read these before comparing, every run):
Labour: open https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/peraturan?keyword=<term>&sort=terbaru (terms: upah, pengupahan, cuti bersama, libur, jaminan, lembur, THR, pesangon) and read the top rows (type, nomor, 'Ditetapkan' date). The detail page links the PDF under /asset/data_puu/. Tax: https://www.pajak.go.id/id/peraturan (newest first, &page=N) and https://jdih.kemenkeu.go.id/search?q=<term>&order=desc (q works; 'keyword' does not). Open /dok/pmk-<n>-tahun-<yyyy>. BPJS TK: berita.html for JP-ceiling SEs; peraturan.html for PPs. BPJS Kesehatan is an Angular shell, so find Perpres JKN changes via Kemnaker JDIH/setneg news and cite the Perpres PDF. UMP/UMK: Kemnaker announces by 1 Nov (UMP) / ~Dec; open jdih.jakarta.go.id homepage for the Kepgub. jdih.jabarprov.go.id and peraturan.bpk.go.id 403 to readers — use Wayback id_ copies or the Kemnaker/BPJS copy. Holidays: kemenkopmk.go.id/pengumuman SKB PDF is a scan; the date list is in the setneg.go.id news text. Discovery only: DDTC News, Ortax, PwC Indonesia Tax Alerts.

facts.label: Enterprise size for BPJS Kesehatan
facts.description: Declare OTHER only after verifying that this employer is not a micro or small enterprise. Perpres 82/2018 art.32(4)–(5), as amended by Perpres 59/2024, excludes micro and small enterprises from the ordinary UMP/UMK BPJS Kesehatan contribution floor; their separate floor requires an actuarial determination. This declaration does not exempt wages from PP 36/2021 minimum-wage rules.

facts.label: Eligible PPh21 DTP sector
facts.description: Employer meets the eligible principal KLU and registration/reference-date conditions of PMK 10/2025 as amended by PMK 72/2025 (2025), or PMK 105/2025 art.3 (2026). Confirm from the DJP record, not merely the current industry label. Employee tax identity, reference-month pay and other incentives are separate PPH21 declarations.

facts.label: Leave cash-out daily divisor
facts.description: The divisor of the monthly wage basis that the employment agreement, company regulation or collective agreement fixes for unused annual leave (UU 13/2003 art.79(4) as amended). Required before any annual leave is cashed out.

facts.label: Leave cash-out wage basis
facts.description: The monthly wage the employment agreement, company regulation or collective agreement values unused annual leave on: BASIC (basic wage) or BASIC_AND_FIXED_ALLOWANCES. Required before any annual leave is cashed out.

facts.label: Export-oriented (sector minimum wage)
facts.description: The employer is an exporter where a sector minimum wage binds only exporters (DKI Kep.33/2026 Lampiran A rows 10–11, KBLI 14111 and 15201: "EKSPOR"). Owner rule 2026-09-28: law silent on an unrecorded condition; default false; lawful because the decree binds only employers that meet the condition, which the employer records, and the run warns rather than pays.

facts.label: Assets above Rp1 trillion (sector minimum wage)
facts.description: The employer’s assets exceed Rp1,000,000,000,000 where a sector minimum wage binds only such employers (DKI Kep.33/2026 Lampiran A row 18, KBLI 21012; Lampiran D rows 51–52, KBLI 64121 and 64122: "ASET DI ATAS 1 TRILIUN"). Owner rule 2026-09-28: law silent on an unrecorded condition; default false; lawful because the decree binds only employers that meet the condition, which the employer records, and the run warns rather than pays.

facts.label: Astra group member (sector minimum wage)
facts.description: The employer belongs to the Astra group where a sector minimum wage binds only it (DKI Kep.33/2026 Lampiran A rows 38–43: "ASTRA GROUP"). Owner rule 2026-09-28: law silent on an unrecorded condition; default false; lawful because the decree binds only employers that meet the condition, which the employer records, and the run warns rather than pays.

facts.label: Hotel star class (sector minimum wage)
facts.description: The verified hotel star class; 0 means affirmatively classified as a non-star hotel. DKI Kep.33/2026 Lampiran F row 60 applies to four/five-star KBLI 55110 hotels; Bali Kep.1021/2025 applies Badung UMSK to four/five-star KBLI 55110 hotels. An unverified class must stop sector selection rather than default to zero.

facts.label: Construction-services employer (JKK 1.74%)
facts.description: The employer is a Pemberi Kerja Jasa Konstruksi that registers its project workers with BPJS Ketenagakerjaan under Permenaker 5/2021 BAB IV (arts.65–67, as amended by Permenaker 1/2025). Its daily casual, piece and fixed-term workers pay JKK at 1.74% of the known monthly wage (art.71(1)), whatever the risk group. Owner rule 2026-09-28: law silent on an unrecorded status; default false; lawful because the employer registers each project itself (art.67).

exit_facts.label: PP 35/2021 termination cause
exit_facts.description: The specific statutory ground; the broad departure reason does not choose a benefit multiplier.

exit_facts.label: Daily wage for separation
exit_facts.description: Article 157(2): the separation monthly wage is 30 times this daily wage.

exit_facts.label: Average output-paid income, last 12 months
exit_facts.description: Article 157(3)-(4): the average is floored at the applicable regional minimum wage.

exit_facts.label: Employer-funded pension benefit
exit_facts.description: Only the benefit attributable to employer contributions may offset termination obligations.

exit_facts.label: Pension offset agreement reference
exit_facts.description: Article 58(3) requires the offset arrangement in the employment agreement, company regulation or collective agreement.

exit_facts.label: Religious holiday the THR is judged against
exit_facts.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Permenaker 6/2016 art.7(1): a PKWTT worker whose employment ends within the thirty days before the religious holiday keeps the THR; art.2(1) and art.5(4): a worker employed on the holiday is owed it; art.7(3): a PKWT that ends before the holiday is not. The religious holiday is the employee’s own (art.1(2): Idul Fitri for a Muslim, Natal for a Christian or Catholic, Nyepi for a Hindu, Waisak for a Buddhist, Imlek for a Confucian), on the date of the government’s joint ministerial decree (SKB) for its year: the first such holiday on or after the thirtieth day before the last day of work.
exit_facts.validation_message: Religious holiday the THR is judged against must be a date written YYYY-MM-DD.

terms_facts.label: Company wage-scale grade
terms_facts.description: PP 36/2021 arts.20, 24 and PP 49/2025 art.21: this worker's grade in the company wage structure and scale, read once service reaches one year.

terms_facts.label: Wage-scale basic-wage minimum
terms_facts.description: The basic-wage minimum of that grade in the company scale (not the government UMP/UMK), in the terms' currency.

terms_facts.label: Wage scale effective on
terms_facts.description: The day the company wage structure and scale took effect.

terms_facts.label: Grade notice given on
terms_facts.description: The day this worker was notified of the grade.

terms_facts.label: Wage scale and grade notice reference
terms_facts.description: The company scale and this worker's individual grade notice; the file is its evidence.

terms_facts.label: Prior work in Indonesia
terms_facts.description: A short-contract foreigner's prior work in Indonesia, checked for the BPJS Kesehatan six-month work condition.

terms_facts.label: Prior work reviewed on
terms_facts.description: The day the prior-work record was reviewed; its reference is the evidence.

terms_facts.label: Worksite KBLI edition
terms_facts.description: The KBLI edition the worksite sector code is stated in.

terms_facts.label: Probation ends on
terms_facts.description: The last day of an agreed PKWTT probation (masa percobaan): UU 13/2003 art.60(1) caps it at three months from the first day of work, and art.60(2) keeps the minimum wage during it. Absent where no probation was agreed; a PKWT (fixed-term contract) may not state one (UU 13/2003 art.58(1); PP 35/2021 art.12).

obligations.description: Register the employer and every worker with BPJS Ketenagakerjaan (JKK, JKM, JHT, JP; JKP follows) and report wage, headcount and data changes
obligations.trigger: Establishment, each hire (a transferring worker is continued from the first day), and any change in wage, headcount, address or participant data
obligations.timing: Registration form with worker and family data within 30 working days of receiving it from BPJS (art.6(1)); the participant card to the worker within 3 working days of receipt (art.7(2)); wage and other changes within 7 working days (art.9(2)–(3))
obligations.owner: HR / registration, card delivery and change reports

obligations.description: Withhold the employee JHT and JP shares and remit them with the employer JKK, JKM, JHT and JP contributions
obligations.trigger: Each contribution month
obligations.timing: "paling lambat tanggal 15 bulan berikutnya", the next working day when the 15th is a holiday; late payment carries a 2% fine for each month late, borne by the employer
obligations.owner: Finance / BPJS Ketenagakerjaan payment and supporting worker data
obligations.authority: PP 44/2015 arts.21–22 (https://www.bpjsketenagakerjaan.go.id/assets/uploads/peraturan/15122015_104557_PP%2044%20Tahun%202015.pdf); PP 45/2015 arts.30–31 (https://www.bpjsketenagakerjaan.go.id/assets/uploads/peraturan/15122015_104556_PP%2045%20Tahun%202015.pdf); JHT under PP 46/2015 is billed with them

obligations.description: Register the employer, each worker and the worker's family (spouse and up to three children) with BPJS Kesehatan; enrol further members the worker elects
obligations.trigger: Each hire; a foreigner once working six months in Indonesia (art.1 angka 2); family changes
obligations.timing: On employment; a worker the employer fails to register may register themselves (art.13(2)) and the employer is sanctioned (art.17)
obligations.authority: Perpres 82/2018 arts.13–14, 17 as amended by Perpres 64/2020 and 59/2024 (https://jdih.kemenkeu.go.id/api/download/FullText/2018/82TAHUN2018PERPRES.pdf)

obligations.description: Collect the 1% (and any elected extra-member 1%) and remit it with the 4% employer contribution
obligations.trigger: Each month
obligations.timing: "paling lambat tanggal 10 setiap bulan", the next working day when the 10th is a holiday (art.39(1),(4)); unpaid by month end suspends cover from the 1st of the next month and the employer bears the care its workers need (art.42)

obligations.description: Report a work accident or occupational disease to BPJS Ketenagakerjaan and the local manpower office
obligations.trigger: A work accident, or an occupational disease diagnosed
obligations.timing: Stage I within 2 x 24 hours of the accident or diagnosis; stage II within 2 x 24 hours of the doctor certifying recovery, disability or death (the benefit claim)
obligations.owner: HR / accident forms and medical certificates

obligations.description: Pay the PPh 21/26 withheld and file the SPT Masa PPh 21/26 with the monthly bukti potong (BPMP for permanent employees January–November) in Coretax
obligations.trigger: Each tax period in which remuneration is paid
obligations.timing: Payment by the 15th of the following month; SPT Masa within 20 days after the period ends; a Saturday, Sunday, public holiday or national cuti bersama moves either to the next working day
obligations.owner: Finance / billing code, payment and SPT Masa receipt
obligations.authority: PMK 81/2024 art.94(2) (payment; https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/306614/pmk-no-81-tahun-2024); UU KUP art.3(3)(a) (SPT Masa 20 days); PER-11/PJ/2025 (https://jdih.kemenkeu.go.id/dok/per-11pj2025); late filing Rp100,000 per SPT Masa (UU KUP art.7(1)), late payment interest (art.9(2a))

obligations.description: Issue Form BPA1 (formerly 1721-A1) to each permanent employee for the year, or for the part year to departure
obligations.trigger: The last tax period: December, or the month a permanent employee stops working
obligations.timing: Within one month after the last tax period ends
obligations.owner: Finance / BPA1 delivered to the employee
obligations.authority: PER-11/PJ/2025 art.7(2) (https://jdih.kemenkeu.go.id/dok/per-11pj2025); PMK 168/2023 (the annual reckoning the form reports)

obligations.description: Obtain each employee's NIK/NPWP and PTKP status (marital status, dependants, a married woman's statement that her husband has no income)
obligations.trigger: Hire, and the start of each calendar year
obligations.timing: PTKP is fixed on the employee's condition at the start of the calendar year (PMK 168/2023 art.9)
obligations.authority: PMK 168/2023 art.9 (https://pajak.go.id/sites/default/files/2024-02/PMK%20168%20Tahun%202023%20Tentang%20PPh%20Pasal%2021%20TER.pdf); UU PPh art.21(5a) (20% higher withholding without NPWP; DJP applies none where a valid NIK is given)

obligations.description: Keep the books, records and documents on which withholding is based
obligations.trigger: Each record
obligations.timing: 10 years in Indonesia

obligations.description: Pay wages in rupiah, in full, at the agreed time, at intervals of not more than one month
obligations.trigger: Each pay date
obligations.timing: The agreed date; the pay interval may not exceed 1 month (art.55(4)). Late wages: 5% per day from the 4th to the 8th day, then +1% per day capped at 50% in a month, then bank interest after a month (art.61)

obligations.description: Give each worker a proof of wage payment with the wage details
obligations.trigger: Each wage payment
obligations.timing: "pada saat Upah dibayarkan" — at the time the wage is paid

obligations.description: Deduct from wages only for fines, damages, advances, rent, debts or overpayment on the required basis, and never more than half of each payment
obligations.trigger: Each deduction other than tax and social security
obligations.timing: Each payment: the total of deductions at most 50% of the wage paid (art.65); rent and debts need written agreement, third-party deductions a revocable power of attorney (arts.63–64)

obligations.description: Pay no worker below the applicable provincial or city/regency minimum wage; basic wage at least 75% of basic plus fixed allowances
obligations.trigger: Each new minimum-wage decree (in force 1 January) and each wage change
obligations.timing: From the decree's commencement
obligations.authority: PP 36/2021 arts.7, 23(3), 25 as amended by PP 51/2023 (https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/161909/pp-no-36-tahun-2021); the governor's UMP/UMK decree for the year

obligations.description: Draw up and apply a wage structure and scale and notify each worker of the grade that applies to them
obligations.trigger: Standing duty; each change
obligations.timing: Standing; each worker notified individually

obligations.description: Pay the religious holiday allowance (THR) before the worker's religious holiday
obligations.trigger: Each religious holiday of the worker (Idulfitri, Christmas, Nyepi, Waisak, Imlek)
obligations.timing: "paling lambat 7 (tujuh) hari sebelum Hari Raya Keagamaan" (art.5(4)); a late payment carries a 5% fine of the THR due (art.10), without discharging the THR

obligations.description: Record each fixed-term employment agreement (PKWT) with the Ministry of Manpower
obligations.trigger: Signing of a PKWT or its extension
obligations.timing: Online within 3 working days of signing; in writing at the city/regency manpower office within 7 working days where the online service is unavailable

obligations.description: Overtime by written or digital order and the worker's consent, a signed list and a record of names and hours; rest and food for long overtime; the daily and weekly caps
obligations.trigger: Overtime is requested or worked
obligations.timing: Before the overtime (order and consent); a list of each worker's overtime hours kept; at most 4 hours a day and 18 a week outside rest days and public holidays; 1,400 kcal of food and drink for 4 hours or more, not payable in cash

obligations.description: Termination by written notice stating the reason, bipartite negotiation on a rejection, and payment of the compensation for the cause
obligations.trigger: Each termination initiated by the employer, and each legally defined cause
obligations.timing: Notice at least 14 working days before termination, 7 during probation (art.37(3)–(4)); the worker may reject in writing within 7 working days, then bipartite negotiation and industrial-relations settlement (art.39)
obligations.owner: HR / notices, consultation, cause and settlement evidence

obligations.description: Report an unopposed termination to the manpower ministry or provincial/regency manpower office
obligations.trigger: The worker received the notice and did not reject it
obligations.timing: After the notice period, on termination

obligations.description: Company employment report (Wajib Lapor Ketenagakerjaan di Perusahaan) through the online WLKP service
obligations.trigger: Establishing, reopening, moving or closing the company; each year
obligations.timing: Within 30 days after or before establishing, reopening or moving (art.6); every year thereafter (art.8)
obligations.authority: UU 7/1981 arts.6, 8 (https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/47039/uu-no-7-tahun-1981); Permenaker 18/2017 as amended by Permenaker 4/2019

obligations.description: Company regulations (Peraturan Perusahaan) for an employer of ten or more workers, ratified by the ministry or manpower office, unless a collective agreement applies
obligations.trigger: Ten or more workers
obligations.timing: In force once ratified; valid at most 2 years and then renewed

obligations.description: Approved foreign-worker employment plan (RPTKA) and the foreign-worker compensation fund (DKPTKA) for each foreign worker
obligations.trigger: Each foreign worker employed
obligations.timing: DKPTKA paid on the billing code before the RPTKA is approved, for the period the worker works in Indonesia (art.23(2)–(5))
obligations.owner: HR / RPTKA approval and DKPTKA receipt

obligations.description: Process worker personal data only on a lawful basis (explicit valid consent, performance of the employment contract, a legal obligation such as BPJS and PPh 21 reporting, vital interests, public task, or legitimate interest); where processing rests on consent, inform the worker of the legality, purpose, data types, retention period, processing period and their rights, and tell them before any change.
obligations.trigger: Collection or processing of an applicant's or worker's personal data
obligations.timing: Before processing; before any change to the information given
obligations.owner: HR / privacy notice and consent record
obligations.authority: UU 27/2022 tentang Pelindungan Data Pribadi arts.20–21 (https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/229798/uu-no-27-tahun-2022); fully applicable from 17 October 2024 (art.74: two years from promulgation on 17 October 2022)

obligations.description: Protect and secure the personal data processed (technical and operational measures, security level set by the data's nature and risk), keep it confidential, supervise every party processing under the controller's control (a payroll vendor), and prevent unlawful processing and access.
obligations.trigger: Holding or processing worker personal data
obligations.timing: Continuous

obligations.description: Carry out a personal data protection impact assessment where processing is high-risk (automated decisions with legal or significant effect, specific data such as health, biometric or financial data, large-scale processing, systematic evaluation, scoring or monitoring, data matching, new technology).
obligations.trigger: Introduction of high-risk processing (for example biometric attendance or large-scale payroll processing of health data)
obligations.timing: Before the high-risk processing begins

obligations.description: Delete personal data no longer needed for its purpose, on withdrawal of consent or request, or when unlawfully obtained; destroy it when its retention period under the archive schedule ends or on request; notify the worker of the deletion or destruction.
obligations.trigger: End of the purpose or retention period, withdrawal of consent, or a data-subject request
obligations.timing: When the condition arises, subject to other statutory retention periods (tax and BPJS records)
obligations.owner: HR / retention schedule and destruction record

obligations.description: On a failure of personal data protection, give written notice to the affected data subjects and to the PDP agency stating the data exposed, when and how it was exposed, and the handling and recovery measures; in certain cases also notify the public.
obligations.trigger: A failure of personal data protection (breach) affecting worker personal data
obligations.timing: No later than 3 × 24 hours

obligations.description: Appoint an officer performing the personal data protection function (internal or external) where processing serves a public service, where core activities require regular and systematic large-scale monitoring, or where core activities are large-scale processing of specific data or criminal-record data.
obligations.trigger: The employer meets an art.53(1) criterion
obligations.timing: Before or when the criterion is met; continuous

checks.message: A PKWTT probation may last at most three months from the first day of work; set probation_end_on no later than the day before the three-month anniversary of the start.
checks.authority: UU 13/2003 art.60(1), not amended by UU 6/2023 (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/peraturan/detail/27/undang-undang-nomor-13-tahun-2003); tracker ID-110

checks.message: A fixed-term contract (PKWT) may not require a probation period: a probation clause is void and its days count as service. Remove probation_end_on from these terms.
checks.authority: UU 13/2003 art.58(1)–(2) as amended by UU 6/2023; PP 35/2021 art.12 (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/asset/data_puu/PP352021.pdf); tracker ID-108, ID-110

checks.message: A PKWT, extensions included, may last at most five years from its start; this contract's recorded end is later. End it within five years or record the employment as PKWTT (open-ended).
checks.authority: PP 35/2021 art.8(1)–(2) (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/asset/data_puu/PP352021.pdf); UU 13/2003 art.56(3) as amended by UU 6/2023, read with MK 168/PUU-XXI/2023 (not more than five years including any extension); tracker ID-108

checks.message: The worker is a child under UU 13/2003 art.1 angka 26 (under 18): art.68 bars employing a child outside the light-work (art.69), curriculum (art.70) and talent (art.71) exceptions, and art.74 bars the worst forms of child labour. Record the exception relied on and its conditions (written parental consent and agreement, at most three hours a day, daytime, outside school hours, safety, wages per law) before paying.
checks.authority: UU 13/2003 arts.1 angka 26, 68–75 as amended by UU 6/2023 (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/peraturan/detail/27/undang-undang-nomor-13-tahun-2003); tracker ID-47 owner default 2026-10-01: the exceptions are lawful, so the run warns rather than refuses

duty_types.label: BPJS Ketenagakerjaan contributions of the wage month (JHT, JKK, JKM, JP)
duty_types.authority: PP 44/2015 art.22(1): paid monthly, at the latest on the 15th of the month after the contribution month (https://www.bpjsketenagakerjaan.go.id/assets/uploads/peraturan/15122015_104557_PP%2044%20Tahun%202015.pdf); PP 45/2015 arts.30–31 (JP); JHT under PP 46/2015 is billed with them. The holiday roll to the next working day is not applied (the obligation site binds no calendar).
duty_types.subject: RUN

duty_types.label: BPJS Kesehatan contribution of the wage month
duty_types.authority: Perpres 82/2018 art.39(1): the employer pays each month's contribution at the latest on the 10th of that month (https://jdih.kemenkeu.go.id/api/download/FullText/2018/82TAHUN2018PERPRES.pdf); tracker ID-20 reading 2026-10-01: the 10th of the wage month itself. The art.39(4) holiday roll is not applied (no calendar on the obligation site).
duty_types.subject: RUN

duty_types.label: PPh 21/26 withheld in the tax period: payment
duty_types.authority: PMK 81/2024 art.94(2): payment by the 15th of the month after the tax period (https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/306614/pmk-no-81-tahun-2024); records kept 10 years (UU KUP art.28(11)). The next-working-day roll is not applied.
duty_types.subject: RUN

duty_types.label: SPT Masa PPh 21/26 with the monthly withholding slips
duty_types.authority: UU KUP art.3(3)(a): the SPT Masa within 20 days after the tax period ends; PER-11/PJ/2025 (https://jdih.kemenkeu.go.id/dok/per-11pj2025); records kept 10 years (UU KUP art.28(11)). The next-working-day roll is not applied.
duty_types.subject: RUN

duty_types.label: Form BPA1 for the tax year (December is the last tax period)
duty_types.authority: PER-11/PJ/2025 art.7(2): BPA1 within one month after the last tax period ends (https://jdih.kemenkeu.go.id/dok/per-11pj2025)
duty_types.subject: RUN

duty_types.label: Form BPA1 for a leaver's part year (the exit month is the last tax period)
duty_types.authority: PER-11/PJ/2025 art.7(2): BPA1 within one month after the last tax period ends (https://jdih.kemenkeu.go.id/dok/per-11pj2025); PMK 168/2023 art.13 (the exit month is the last tax period). Raised for every leaver; waive it for a nonpermanent recipient, who takes a BPMP instead.
duty_types.subject: EMPLOYMENT

duty_types.label: PHK notice to BPJS Ketenagakerjaan for a JKP participant (SIAPkerja)
duty_types.authority: Permenaker 2/2025 art.9: within seven working days of the termination (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/asset/data_puu/2025pmnaker002.pdf); PP 37/2021 as amended by PP 6/2025 art.20: resignation, retirement, total permanent disability, death and the end of a PKWT term are not JKP terminations. Owner default 2026-10-01: working days are Monday to Friday; public holidays and cuti bersama are not skipped (the obligation site binds no calendar), so a window holding a holiday falls due a day early. Waive it for a worker who is not a JKP participant (a foreigner, or 54 or over when registered).
